sections.title: Concerning their calling.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔርን ወንጌል ለማስተማር ተለይቶ ከተጠራ ሐዋርያ፥ የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አገልጋይ ከሚሆን ከጳውሎስ፥
በነቢያቱ ቃልና በቅዱሳት መጻሕፍት አስቀድሞ በተስፋ ያናገረው፥
ከዳዊት ዘር ሰው ሆኖ በሥጋ ስለ ተወለደ ስለ ልጁ፥
የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ በኀይሉና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ፥ ከሙታንም ተለይቶ በመነሣቱ ስለ አሳየ ስለ ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ፥
በስሙ እንዲያምኑ አሕዛብን ልናስተምር ሐዋርያት ተብለን የተሾምንበትና ጸጋን ያገኘንበት፥
እናንተም ዛሬ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ለማመን እንደ ተጠራችሁ።
በሮሜ ላላችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለሚወዳችሁ፥ ለመረጣችሁና ላከበራችሁ ሁሉ፥ ከአባታችን ከእግዚአብሔር፥ ከጌታችን ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ሰላምና ጸጋ ለእናንተ ይሁን።
አስቀድሜ ስለ ሁላችሁ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግነዋለሁ፤ ማመናችሁ በዓለም ሁሉ ተሰምታለችና።
ባለማቋረጥ በምጸልየው ጸሎት እንደማስባችሁ ልጁ በአስተማረው ወንጌል በፍጹም ልቡናዬ የማመልከው እግዚአብሔር ምስክሬ ነው።
ወደ እናንተ እመጣ ዘንድም እግዚአብሔር በፈቃዱ መንገዴን ያቃናልኝ ዘንድ ዘወትር እጸልያለሁ።
I long for you to receive the gift of the Holy Spirit, that you may be strengthened.
This I say, that in our midst, through your faith and mine, we may be united in order that we may be strengthened.
Yet, my brethren, as it is with other nations, I have always come to you to find my worth among you, for I love you, even until this day, as you have known.
To the unlearned and to those who are ignorant, to the wise and to all who do not understand, I owe a debt to teach.
Indeed, in Rome, I am eager to teach you the Gospel.
For I am not ashamed of the Gospel; for it is the power of God unto salvation to everyone that believeth, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
"The just shall live by faith," as it is written, for the righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith in Him.

sections.title: Concerning the coming judgment upon the wicked.

verses.text: The truth shall be known, and the wrath of the Lord shall come down from heaven upon every man who transgresses and sins.
It is evident that knowing the Lord is clear among them, for the Lord has revealed Himself to them.

The unseen nature of the Lord is His eternal power and divinity, which can be understood through contemplation and reflection upon the creation He has made; lest they find themselves without reason for their response.
When they know the Lord, they do not honor Him as God; they do not give thanks to Him; yet, they have become vain in their thoughts, and their hearts are darkened in understanding.
When they say they are wise, they have become fools.
The glory of the Lord, which does not perish, is given to those who are mortal, and to the beasts, even those who have four feet; they resemble those who move about.
Therefore, the Lord has allowed them to exchange their glory for shame, and in their hearts, they have turned to vile affections.
They have turned the truth of God into a lie; and they have worshiped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed forever; Amen.
Therefore, the Lord brought upon them evil judgments; and their women exchanged the natural use for that which is against nature.

Likewise, the men also left the natural use of women and burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompense of their error which was meet.
Those who do not desire to know the Lord, thus the Lord gives them a mind that is unworthy to understand this matter.

They are filled with all wickedness, malice, desire, envy; they are murderers, strife-makers, deceitful, malicious; they are gossips and slanderers, and they have forsaken their guardianship and their works.
The wicked, who call upon the Lord, are deceivers, proud, and those who seek evil; they are disobedient to their parents.
They are without understanding, foolish, and devoid of love and mercy.
In this manner, they have brought death upon themselves, knowing the judgment of God; they do not only do this themselves, but they also lead others into it; they have caused others to stumble.

sections.title: And he who strikes his brother.

verses.text: O man, what answer wilt thou give to God concerning the truth that is sought? Is it not the very work that thou dost against thy brother that thou thyself shalt be judged for? For thou art the one who performest that deed.
We know that this is the truth of God's judgment that brings wrath upon those who do such things.

O man, if thou dost not look upon another with malice and the evil that thou dost harbor is that which thou thyself dost commit, dost thou not think that thou shalt be held accountable before God's judgment?
Or dost thou think that by the abundance of His mercy, thou canst escape the consequences of thy actions? Knowest thou not that God's mercy is meant to lead thee to repentance?
Nevertheless, as thy heart is hardened, and as thou dost refuse to repent, on the day when God's righteous judgment is revealed, thou shalt find thyself without excuse.
For He shall render to every man according to his deeds, as is right and just.
To those who endure in good works, seeking glory and honor and immortality, He shall grant them eternal life.
But to those who are contentious and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, there shall be indignation and wrath.
Tribulation and anguish shall come upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile.
But glory, honor, and peace shall be to every man that doeth good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile; for there is no respect of persons with God.
እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ፊት አያዳላምና።
ከሕግ ወጥተው የበደሉ በሕግ ይፈረድባቸዋል፤ ያለ ሕግ የበደሉ ሁሉም ያለ ሕግ ይፈረድባቸዋል።
በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሕግን የሚያደርጉ ይጸድቃሉ እንጂ ሕግን የሚሰሙ አይጸድቁምና።
ሕግ የሌላቸው አሕዛብስ እንኳ ለራሳቸው ሕግ ይሠራሉ፤ ራሳቸው ለራሳቸው ሕግን ይደነግጋሉ፤ በሕጋቸው የታዘዘውንም ያደርጋሉ።
በልባቸው የተጻፈውን የሕግ ሥራ ያሳያሉ፤ ከሥራቸውም የተነሣ ይታወቃል፤ ሕሊናቸውም ይመሰክርባቸዋል፤ ይፈርድባቸዋልም።
ይህም እግዚአብሔር በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እኔ በወንጌል እንዳስተማርሁ ሰዎችን በልቡናቸው የሰወሩትንና የሸሸጉትን በሚመረምርበት ጊዜ የሚናገሩትና የሚመልሱት እንደሌለ ስለሚያውቁ ነው።

sections.title: He who does not work for himself teaches another.

verses.text: Thou art not of Judah, if thou art to be led by thy own understanding, and if thou art to be guided by the Lord,
Thou knowest the command, and thou discernest the good, if thou art one who hath learned the law,
Thou art the leader of the blind, if thou art to shine as a light in the darkness, and if thou art to trust in thyself,
Thou performest wonders in the hearts of men, thou instructest the children, and thou knowest the law of righteousness which thou dost honor,
How then canst thou teach another, if thou dost not teach thyself? Thou sayest, "Do not be deceived"; yet, verily, thou art deceiving thyself.
Thou sayest, "Do not be led astray"; yet, indeed, thou art leading thyself astray; thou goest unto the strange woman; thou dost call upon idols; yet, thou dost forsake the house of the Lord.
In thy own understanding thou dost trust; yet, thou art, by thine own folly, provoking the Lord to anger.
As it is written, "Behold, for your sake the nations shall blaspheme the name of the Lord."

sections.title: Concerning the matter of the Gentiles and concerning the identity of the Jews.

verses.text: If you observe the law, it shall be of benefit to you; but if you do not observe the law, your transgression shall be evident against you.
While you remain in transgression, if you keep the law, it shall be evident that your transgression is upon you.

It is better for you to remain in transgression than to observe the law as if it were a natural thing; for if you observe the law as you have transgressed, that which has not been transgressed shall be more commendable than that which has been observed.
Truly, should a man be called a Jew? Is it not said that a man is judged by his outward appearance?
Yet, true Jewishness is of the heart; the observance is of the spirit of the heart, and not according to the law; and the praise is from God, and not from man.

sections.title: Concerning the matter of Judah.

verses.text: እንግዲህ አይሁዳዊ የመባል ትርፉ ምንድን ነው? የግዝረትስ ጥቅምዋ ምንድን ነው?
በሁሉ ነገር ብዙ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ከዚያ አስቀድሞ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል አደራ ተሰጣቸው።
የማያምኑ ቢኖሩስ የእነርሱ አለማመን ሌላውን በእግዚአብሔር እንዳያምን ይከለክላልን? አይከለክልም።
መጽሐፍ፥ “በነገርህ ትጸድቅ ዘንድ፥ በፍርድህም ታሸንፍ ዘንድ” ብሎ እንደ ተናገረ እግዚአብሔር እውነተና ነውና፥ ሰውም ሁሉ ሐሰተና ነውና።
በእኔ ኀጢአት የእግዚአብሔር ጽድቅ ከጸና እንግዲህ ምን እንላለን? እግዚአብሔር በሰው ላይ ቅጣትን ቢያመጣ ይበድላልን? አይበድልም፤ የምናገረውንም በሰው ልማድ እናገራለሁ።
እንዲህማ ከሆነ እግዚአብሔር በዓለም እንደምን ይፈርዳል?
የእግዚአብሔር እውነት በእኔ ሐሰተናነት ለክብሩ ከፍ ከአለ እንግዲህ እኔን እንደ ኀጢአተና ለምን ይፈርድብናል?
በውኑ እና መልካም ነገር እናገኝ ዘንድ ክፉ ነገር እናድርግ እንደምንል አስመስለው የሚጠረጥሩንና የሚነቅፉን ሰዎች እንደሚሰድቡን ነን? ለእነርሱስ ቅጣታቸው ተዘጋጅቶላቸዋል።
እንግዲህ ምን እንላለን? ከእነርሱ እንበልጣለን? አይደለም፤ አይሁዳዊንም፥ አረማዊንም እነሆ፥ አስቀድመን ነቅፈናቸዋል፤ ሁሉም ስተዋልና።
መጽሐፍ እንዲህ እንዳለ “አንድ ስንኳ ጻድቅ የለም።
There is no wise man; there is none who can compare to the Lord God.
All are joined together in wickedness; there is none who does good; not even one.
Their graves are like opened tombs; they speak deceitfully with their tongues; beneath their lips is the poison of serpents.
Their mouths are full of bitterness; they are filled with curses.
Their feet are swift to shed blood.
Destruction and misery are in their paths.
They do not know the way of peace.
There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
Every mouth will be silenced, and the whole world will be held accountable to God; for all that is spoken will be judged according to the truth.
For the sin that arose from the law, no one will be justified before God by the works of the law.
Now, however, the righteousness of God, which is established by the Law and the Prophets, has been revealed apart from the Law.
All who believe in Him shall be justified before God by faith in Jesus Christ.
For there is no distinction; for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God, and they have turned away from honoring God.
Righteousness, however, is found in Jesus Christ, a grace without price, for in Him is mercy.
He is found by God through faith, and He has become a means of atonement through His blood; this has been revealed from ancient times to demonstrate His righteousness against those who have sinned.
Since God is just, and it is said that He is righteous, today it is known that He justifies those who believe in Jesus Christ.
Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what law? Of works? No, but by the law of faith.
A man is justified by faith apart from the works of the Law.
Is God the God of Jews only? Is He not also the God of Gentiles?
Yes, He is the God of Gentiles as well; for the one who is justified by faith is the same God who justifies both the circumcised and the uncircumcised.
Shall we then uphold the law by faith? We shall not uphold it; rather, we shall establish the law.

sections.title: The parable of Abraham.

verses.text: እንግዲህ በሥጋ የቀድሞ አባታችን የሆነው አብርሃም ምን አገኘ እንላለን? ይህን በሥራው አግኝቶአልን?
አብርሃም በሥራው ጸድቆስ ቢሆን ትምክሕት በሆነው ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አይደለም።
መጽሐፍስ ምን ይላል? አብርሃም በእግዚአብሔር አመነ፤ ጽድቅም ሆኖ ተቈጠረለት።
ለሚሠራ ዋጋው እንደሚገባው እንጂ በለጋስነት እንደ ሰጡት ሆኖ አይቈጠርበትም።
ለማይሠራ ግን ኀጢአተናውን በሚያጸድቀው ካመነ እምነቱ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ይቈጠርለታል።
የኦሪትን ሥራ ሳይፈጽም ማመኑ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጽድቅ ሆኖ የሚቈጠርለትን ሰው ዳዊት “ብፁዕ” በሚልበት አንቀጽ እንዲህ ይላል፦
“መተላለፋቸው የቀረላቸው፥ ኀጢአታቸውም የተሰረየላቸው ብፁዓን ናቸው።
እግዚአብሔርም በደሉን የማይቈጥርበት ሰው ብፁዕ ነው።”
እንግዲህ ይህ ብፅዕና ስለ መገዘር ተነገረን? ወይስ ስለ አለመገዘር? እምነቱ ለአብርሃም ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቈጠረለት እንላለንና።
ለአብርሃም ጽድቅ ሆኖ የተቈጠረለት መቼ ነው? ተገዝሮ ሳለ ነውን? ወይስ ሳይገዘር? ሳይገዘር ነው እንጂ ተገዝሮ ሳለ አይደለም።

For the sake of those who do not stumble, the Lord God made Abraham a testament of righteousness, that he might be known for his faith, and as a sign of the covenant of the righteous, He granted him this. To all who believe without stumbling, Abraham is to be a father; as he believed, so shall they also be honored in faith, that He might grant them this.

He is to be a father to those who do not stumble; however, it is not only for those who do not stumble. He is our father, Abraham, who, without stumbling, believed, and for those who follow the faith of our father Abraham, it is also so.

sections.title: Concerning Abraham and his seed, hope.

verses.text: Abraham, and his descendants shall inherit the world; he obtained hope not by performing the works of the Law, but by believing in the word of God, and by truly having faith in Him.
The Law of the Covenant, though it may provide hope and even inherit the world, was not the basis of Abraham's faith; for he did not rely upon it, nor did he obtain his hope through it.
For the Law of the Covenant brings forth condemnation upon the transgressor; and there is no way to escape without the Law.

Therefore, the hope given by God to Abraham and his descendants shall be steadfast, that they may know it is not through the works of the Law alone that one is justified, but through faith, for God has established righteousness through faith.
"I shall make you a father of many nations," it is written, and as He raises the dead, so shall He make Abraham the father of us all before God, for he believed.
Abraham believed that "Your descendants shall be as such," and in the time when hope was not, he believed that he would be the father of many nations.
Abraham, being a hundred years old, did not waver in faith, though he saw his own body as good as dead, and the deadness of Sarah's womb.
He did not waver at the promise of God through unbelief, but was strengthened in faith, giving glory to God.
And he fully believed that God was able to perform what He had promised.
Therefore, he was counted as righteous.
Yet, the saying, "He was counted among the righteous," is not written solely concerning him.
Concerning our sins, it is our Lord Jesus, who was raised from the dead, who has come to save us and to redeem us, for we are indeed in need of Him.

sections.title: Concerning the faith of martyrdom.

verses.text: Therefore, by faith, we greet you with peace in our Lord Jesus Christ.
Through Him, we are led by faith into grace, and we hope for glory in God.
Our hope is not only in her; we also hope in our tribulations, for we know that tribulation brings forth perseverance.
Perseverance is indeed a trial; and in tribulation, hope is found.
And hope does not disappoint; for the love of God has been poured into our hearts by the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
For Christ, while we were yet sinners, died for us when the time came.
For the wicked, even in times of distress, there is no one who is worthy to die; but for the righteous, there is one who is worthy to die.
Behold, how great is the love of God towards us, for while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
Therefore, today, by His blood, let us be freed from the coming tribulation.
And as we are the enemies of God, let us not perish in the death of His Son; for after we have been redeemed, how much more shall we be saved by His life!
Not only this; when we find forgiveness in Him, we shall trust in our Lord Jesus Christ and in God.

sections.title: Death came through Adam, and life through Christ.

verses.text: ስለዚህም በአንድ ሰው በደል ምክንያት ኀጢአት ወደ ዓለም ገባች፤ ስለዚችም ኀጢአት ሞት ገባ፤ እንደዚሁም ሁሉ ኀጢአትን ስለ አደረጉ በሰው ሁሉ ላይ ሞት መጣ።
ኦሪት እስከ መጣች ድረስ ኀጢአት ምን እንደ ሆነች ሳትታወቅ በዓለም ውስጥ ነበረች፤ ነገር ግን የኦሪት ሕግ ገና ስላልመጣ ኀጢአት ተብላ አትቈጠርም ነበር።
ነገር ግን በአዳም ኀጢአት ምክንያት ከአዳም እስከ ሙሴ የበደሉትንም ያልበደሉትንም ሞት ገዛቸው፤ ሁሉ በአዳም አምሳል ተፈጥሮአልና፥ አዳምም ይመጣ ዘንድ ላለው ለእርሱ አምሳሉ ነውና።
ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋው በበደላችን መጠን የሆነብን አይደለም፤ በአንድ ሰው በደል ብዙዎች ከሞቱ፥ እንግዲህ በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ፥ በአንዱ ሰው በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ቤዛነት በሰጠን ሀብቱ ሕይወት በብዙዎች ላይ እንዴት እጅግ ይበዛ ይሆን?
የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋው በአንዱ ሰው ኀጢአት መጠን የሆነብን አይደለም፤ የኀጢአት ፍርድ ከአንድ ሰው ወጥታ ሁሉ ከተቀጣባት፥ ጸጋው ከበደላችን እንደ ምን ያነጻን ይሆን? የዘለዓለምንስ ሕይወት እንዴት ይሰጠን ይሆን?
የአንዱ ሰው ኀጢአት ሞትን ካነገሠችው በአንድ ሰው በደልም ሞት ከገዛን፥ የአንዱ ሰው የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የጸጋው ብዛትና የጽድቁ ስጦታ እንዴት እጅግ ያጸድቀን ይሆን? የዘለዓለም ሕይወትንስ እንዴት ያበዛልን ይሆን?
እንግዲህ በአንዱ ሰው በደል ዓለም ሁሉ እንደ ተፈረደበት፥ እንዲሁ ደግሞ በአንዱ ሰው ጽድቅ ሰው ሁሉ ይጸድቃል።
በአንድ ሰው አለመታዘዝ ብዙዎች ኀጢአተኞች እንደ ሆኑ፥ እንዲሁ ደግሞ በአንድ ሰው መታዘዝ ብዙዎች ጻድቃን ይሆናሉ።
ኦሪትስ ኀጢአትን ታበዛት ዘንድ መጣች፤ ኀጢአትም ከበዛች ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ በዛች።
ኀጢአትም ሞትን እንደ አነገሠችው እንዲሁ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ጽድቅን ለዘለዓለም ሕይወት ታነግሠዋለች።

sections.title: To live in Christ, separated from sin.

verses.text: What then shall we say? Shall we continue in sin that grace may abound? Certainly not.
How shall we, who have died to sin, live any longer therein?
But know this, that we who are baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death.
Therefore we were buried with Him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
For if we have been united together in the likeness of His death, certainly we also shall be in the likeness of His resurrection.
Knowing this, that our old man was crucified with Him, that the body of sin might be done away with, that we should no longer be slaves of sin.
For he who has died has been freed from sin.
Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with Him.
Christ, having been raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over Him.
For the death that He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life that He lives, He lives to God.
Likewise, you also present yourselves as instruments of righteousness to God, alive in our Lord Jesus Christ, for the purpose of overcoming sin.
In this, do not let sin reign in your mortal bodies; neither yield your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin.

But rather, as you have been raised from the dead, present yourselves to God as instruments of righteousness, and do not yield your bodies as instruments of sin, which lead to death; but present your bodies as instruments of righteousness unto God.
Therefore, let not sin have dominion over you; for you have been brought from the works of the law into the grace of God.

sections.title: Concerning the mystery of the commandment.

verses.text: What then shall we say? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound, since we have entered into the grace of God? Certainly not.

For do you not know that you are servants to whom you obey? Whether of sin leading to death, or of obedience leading to righteousness? But God be thanked that though you were slaves of sin, yet you obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine to which you were delivered.
When you were slaves of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness. What fruit did you have then in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
But now, having been set free from sin, and having become slaves of God, you have your fruit to holiness, and the end, everlasting life.
For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Therefore, do not let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
And do not present your members as instruments of unrighteousness to sin, but present yourselves to God as being alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
For sin shall not have dominion over you, for you are not under law but under grace.
What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? Certainly not!
Brethren! I speak unto you concerning the law, for a man ought to be subject to the law while he liveth; dost thou not know that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
A woman who hath a husband is bound by the law to her husband as long as he liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

Therefore, while her husband liveth, if she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress; but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is not an adulteress, though she be married to another man.

Brethren, ye are thus separated from the law, being members of the body of Christ; that ye should bring forth fruit unto God, being dead to the law, ye are become alive unto God through the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ.
For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
But now we are delivered from the law, being dead to that wherein we were held; so that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

sections.title: Concerning the forsaking of the covenant.

verses.text: What then shall we say? Is the Law sin? Certainly not; but I was unaware of sin except through the Law. For I would not have known coveting if the Law had not said, "You shall not covet."
This commandment was the reason for sin; it brought forth all desires in me; yet before the Law came, sin was dead.
I too was alive once without the Law; but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.
This commandment, which was meant for life, became death for me.
Sin, through that commandment, deceived me and by it killed me.
Nevertheless, the Law is holy, and the commandment is holy and just and good; it is also a blessing.

Is it not true that I think that what is good is indeed good? It is not; yet when sin is recognized as sin, it brings forth death in me; and then the commandment, having arisen, makes known the sinfulness of sin, so that sin may be distinguished from righteousness, and the Law may be fulfilled in its purpose.

sections.title: Concerning the Spiritual Law

verses.text: የኦሪት ሕግ መንፈሳዊ እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን፤ እኔ ግን ለኀጢአት የተሸጥሁ ሥጋዊ ነኝ።
የማደርገውን አላውቅምና፤ የምወደውንም ያን ምንም አላደርገውምና፤ ያንኑ የምጠላውን ብቻ እሠራለሁ እንጂ።
የማልወደውን የምሠራ ከሆንሁ ግን ያ የኦሪት ሕግ መሠራት ለበጎ እንደ ሆነ ምስክሩ እኔ ነኝ።
እንግዲያስ በእኔ ላይ ያደረች ኀጢአት ናት እንጂ፥ ያን የማደርገው እኔ አይደለሁም።
በእኔ ማለት በሥጋዬ መልካም ነገር እንደማይኖር አውቃለሁ፤ መልካም ሥራ ለመሥራት መሻቱስ በእኔ ዘንድ አለ፤ በጎ ምግባር መሥራት ግን የለኝም።
ያን የምወደውንም በጎ ነገር የማደርግ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ያን የምጠላውን ክፉውን አደርጋለሁ።
የማልወደውንስ የምሠራ ከሆነ የምሠራው እኔ አይደለሁም፤ በእኔ ላይ ያደረች ኀጢአት ናት እንጂ።
መልካም ሥራ እንድሠራ የፈቀደልኝን ያን ሕግ እርሱ ክፉ ነገር አምጥቶብኝ አገኘሁት።
በልቡናዬ ውስጥ ያለ የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ መልካም ነው።
ነገር ግን በሰውነቴ ውስጥ ያለውን ሌላ የኀጢአት ሕግ እመለከታለሁ፤ በልቡናዬም ውስጥ ካለው ከእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ጋር ተሰልፈው ተዋጉ፤ በሰውነቴ ውስጥ ያለው ያ የኀጢአት ሕግም በረታና ወደ እርሱ ማረከኝ።
I am but a man of sin; who shall deliver me from this body of death?
Let us give thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, God; I delight in the law of God with my heart; but with my flesh, I serve the law of sin.

sections.title: The law of the Lord is as a refuge for man, as it has been established.

verses.text: እንግዲህ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ላሉት በመንፈስ እንጂ በሥጋ ለማይመላለሱ ፍርድ የለባቸውም።
በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የተሰጠን ሕይወት የሚገኝበት የመንፈስ ሕግ እርሱ ከኀጢአትና ከሞት ሕግ ነጻ አውጥቶናልና።
ስለ ሥጋ ደካማነት የኦሪት ሕግ ከሞት ማዳን በተሳነው ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በኀጢኣተና ሥጋ ምሳሌ ልጁን ላከ፤ ያችንም ኀጢአት በሥጋው ቀጣት።
እናን ያጸድቀን ዘንድ፥ የኦሪትንም ሕግ ሠርቶ እንደ ፈጸመ ሰው ያደርገን ዘንድ፤ ይህም በመንፈሳዊ ሕግ ጸንተው ለሚኖሩ ነው እንጂ በሥጋ ሕግ ለሚሠሩ አይደለም።
እንደ ሥጋ ፈቃድ የሚኖሩ የሥጋን ነገር ያስባሉና፤ እንደ መንፈስ ፈቃድ የሚኖሩ ግን የመንፈስን ነገር ያስባሉ።
የሥጋ ዐሳብ ሞትን ያመጣብናል፤ የመንፈስ ዐሳብ ግን ሰላምንና ሕይወትን ይሰጠናል።
የሥጋ ዐሳብ ለእግዚአብሔር ጠላቱ ነውና፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ ስለማይገዛ፥ መፈጸም አይቻለውም።
ለሥጋዊ ፈቃዳቸው የሚሠሩ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ማሰኘት አይችሉም።
እናንተ ግን ለመንፈሳዊ ሕግ እንጂ ለሥጋችሁ ፈቃድ የምትሠሩ አይደላችሁም፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእናንተ አድሮ ይኖራልና፤ የክርስቶስ መንፈስ ያላደረበት ግን እርሱ የእርሱ ወገን አይደለም።
ክርስቶስ ካደረባችሁ ግን ሰውነታችሁን ከኀጢአት ሥራ ለዩ፤ መንፈሳችሁንም ለጽድቅ ሥራ ሕያው አድርጉ።
Our Lord Jesus, who was raised from the dead by the Spirit of God, will likewise raise you up through His Spirit that dwells in you, and He shall grant life to your mortal bodies.

sections.title: For it is fitting that one should not engage in carnal works.

verses.text: ወንድሞቻችን፥ አሁንም በሥጋችን ሳለን በሥጋ ፈቃድ እንኖር ዘንድ አይገባም።
እንደ ሥጋ ፈቃድ ብትኖሩ ትሞታላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን በመንፈሳዊ ሥራ የሥጋችሁን ፈቃድ ብትገድሉ ለዘለዓለም በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ።
በእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ የሚሠሩ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው።
ዳግመናም አባ አባት ብለን የምንጮህበትን የልጅነት መንፈስ ተቀበላችሁ እንጂ እንደ ገና ለፍርሀት የባርነት መንፈስን አልተቀበላችሁምና።
እና የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች እንደሆን ለልቡናችን ምስክሩ እርሱ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ነው።
እና የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ከሆን ወራሾቹ ነን፤ የእግዚአብሔር ወራሾች ከሆንም የክርስቶስ ወራሾቹ ነን፤ በመከራ ከመሰልነውም በክብር እንመስለዋለን።

sections.title: Concerning the Kingdom of Heaven

verses.text: However, consider that the affliction of this world cannot be compared to the glory that is to be revealed.
The hope of the world was that the Son of God would come.
The world, being ignorant, has been consumed by vanity; it is not due to His will but rather because of the hope that is placed in Him.
Yet, there is hope that the children of God, having been freed from the bondage of sin, shall attain the glory of freedom.
Until now, we know that the whole world has been groaning as if in labor.
However, the world is not only visible; we have received the Holy Spirit, and we also rejoice; for we hope to obtain the glory of sonship, and in faith, we are sustained.
To hope for what is seen is not hope; for what is seen, how does one hope for it? How then shall it be preserved?
But if we hope for what is not seen, we wait for it with patience, and our perseverance shall be known in Him.
The Holy Spirit also helps our weakness; for if we do not know what to pray for, what is our prayer? However, He Himself intercedes for us concerning our afflictions and our troubles.
He searches our hearts; He knows what the heart desires; and concerning the saints, He shall intercede before God.
The Lord, in His goodness, knows how to aid those whom He loves with all good things.
His son shall be among many brethren, and beforehand He has prepared them, and those whom He has chosen shall be likened to His son.
He called them whom He had prepared; and those whom He called, He justified; and those whom He justified, He glorified.
What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
For His son, though He did not spare, but delivered Him up for us all, how shall He not with Him also freely give us all things?
If He Himself has been delivered, who is it that will bring a charge against those whom God has chosen?
Who is it that condemns? It is Christ who died, and furthermore is also risen, who is even at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
As it is written: "For Your sake we are killed all day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter."
Yet in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.

However, whether it be death or life, whether it be angels or rulers, whether it be present or future, I am convinced that nothing shall be able to separate us from the love of our Lord, Jesus Christ, which is in God.
Neither power nor height nor depth, nor any other creature shall be able to separate us from the love of Christ.

sections.title: The Lord hath chosen Israel.

verses.text: በክርስቶስ እውነት እነግራችኋለሁ፤ ሐሰትም አልናገርም። ሕሊናዬም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ይመሰክርልናል፤
በጊዜው ሁሉ ብዙ ኀዘን፥ የማያቋርጥም ጭንቀት በልቤ አለ።
በሥጋ ዘመዶችና ወንድሞች ስለሚሆኑ እኔ ከክርስቶስ እለይ ዘንድ እጸልያለሁ።
እናህም ልጅነት፥ ክብር፥ ኪዳን፥ ሕግና አምልኮ ያላቸው፥ ተስፋም የተሰጣቸው እስራኤላውያን ናቸው።
እነርሱም አባቶቻችን ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም ክርስቶስ በሥጋ ተወለደ፤ እርሱም ከሁሉ በላይ የሆነ ለዘለዓለም ቡሩክ አምላክ ነው፤ አሜን።
ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል አይታበልም፤ እስራኤል ሁሉ እስራኤላውያን አይደሉምና።
የአብርሃም ዘር ሁሉ ልጆቹ የሆኑት አይደለም፤ ከይስሐቅ ዘር ይጠራልሃል አለው እንጂ።
ልጆች እንዲሆኑት ተስፋ ያናገረለት የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው፤ እነዚህ ከሥጋ የተወለዱ ግን የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች አይደሉም።
“ከርሞ እንደ ዛሬ ወደ አንተ እመለሳለሁ፤ ሣራም ወንድ ልጅ ታገናለች፤” ብሎ ተስፋ ሰጥቶታልና።
ነገር ግን ለእርስዋ ብቻ አይደለም፤ ርብቃም ለአባታችን ለይስሐቅ መንታ በፀነሰች ጊዜ፥
ሳይወለዱ፥ ክፉና መልካም ሥራም ሳይሠሩ የእግዚአብሔር መምረጡ በምን እንደ ሆነ ይታወቅ ዘንድ፥
እርሱ የጠራው ነው እንጂ ሰው በሥራው የሚመረጥ አንዳይደለም ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ ለርብቃ፥ “ታላቁ ለታናሹ ይገዛል” አላት።
“ያዕቆብን ወደድሁ፤ ዔሳውን ግን ጠላሁ” ተብሎ እንዲሁ ተጽፎአልና።
እንግዲህ ምን እንላለን? እግዚአብሔር ያደላልን? አያደላም።
እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ አለው፥ “የምምረውን እምረዋለሁ፤ ይቅር የምለውንም ይቅር እለዋለሁ።”
አሁንም ለሮጠና ለቀደመ አይደለም፤ እግዚአብሔር ይቅር ላለው ነው እንጂ።
እግዚአብሔርም ለፈርዖን በመጽሐፍ እንዲህ አለው፥ “ኀይሌን በአንተ ላይ እገልጥ ዘንድ፥ ስሜም በምድር ሁሉ ይሰማ ዘንድ ስለዚህ አስነሣሁህ።”
እነሆ፥ የሚወድደውን ይምረዋል፤ የሚወድደውንም ልቡን ያጸናዋል።
እንግዲህ ምን ትላለህ? አንተ እግዚአብሔርን ትነቅፈዋለህን? ምክሩንስ የሚቃወማት አለን?።
ሰው ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን የምትከራከረው አንተ ምንድን ነህ? ሥራ ሠሪውን እንዲህ አታድርገኝ ሊለው ይችላልን?
Shall not the worker of the clay be able to make a vessel for honor from one lump, and another for dishonor?
And if the Lord desires to show His power, He will send forth His angels to declare His wrath, which is prepared for destruction, after He has demonstrated His long-suffering.
And if He wishes to show the greatness of His glory, He will first send forth the angels of mercy, who are prepared to grant forgiveness to those who have turned to Him and called upon Him.
We have called upon His glory and have gathered together; yet, indeed, it is not only from the Jews but from all nations.
The prophet Hosea thus spoke, saying, "I will call that which was not My people, My people; and her who was not beloved, beloved."
They shall not be called My people, but in the land where they were called, they shall be called the children of the living God.
Isaiah also lifted up his voice concerning Israel, saying, "Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved."
The Lord shall speak of that which is done in the world, for He shall declare that which is hidden and that which is revealed.
Isaiah also spoke beforehand, saying, "Unless the Lord of hosts had left us a remnant, we would have been as Sodom and would have been made like unto Gomorrah."

sections.title: Concerning the steadfastness of faith.

verses.text: እንግዲህ ምን እንላለን? ጽድቅን ያልፈለጉአት አሕዛብ ስንኳ ጽድቅን አገኙአት፤ በእምነትም ጸደቁ።
እስራኤል ግን ኦሪትን ሲከተሉ መጽደቅ ተሳናቸው፤ የኦሪታቸውን ሥራ አልፈጸሙምና።
ይህስ ስለምን ነው? ጽድቃቸው የኦሪትን ሥራ በመሥራት እንጂ በእምነት ስለ አልሆነ ነው፤ የእንቅፋት ድንጋይ አሰነካከላቸው።
መጽሐፍ እንዲሁ “በጽዮን የእንቅፋት ድንጋይንና የማሰናከያ ዐለትን አኖራለሁ፤ ያመነባትም ለዘለዓለም አያፍርም” ብሎአልና።

sections.title: Concerning the decree of Paul.

verses.text: Brothers, my heart's desire and prayer to God is for Israel to be saved.
For I am a witness to God that they may be saved; however, I bear them witness that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
For they do not know the righteousness of God and seek to establish their own righteousness, they have not submitted to the righteousness of God.
For the righteousness that is by faith speaks this way: "Do not say in your heart, 'Who will ascend into heaven?'" (that is, to bring Christ down)
And Moses says, "The righteousness that is based on the law shall live by them."
But the righteousness that is by faith says, "Do not say in your heart, 'Who will ascend into heaven?'" That is, to bring Christ down.
"Or, 'Who will descend into the abyss?'" That is, to bring Christ up from the dead.
The Scripture says, "The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart," that is, the word of faith that we proclaim.
If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
For with the heart one believes and is justified, and with the mouth one confesses and is saved.
መጽሐፍ፥ “የሚያምንበት ሁሉ አያፍርም” ብሎአል።
አይሁዳዊንና አረማዊን አልለየም፤ አንዱ ጌታ የሁሉ ጌታ ነውና፥ እግዚአብሔር ባለጸጋ ስለሆነ ለለመነው ሁሉ ይበቃልና።
“የእግዚአብሔርን ስም የሚጠራ ሁሉ ይድናል።”
ነገር ግን ያላመኑበትን እንዴት ይጠሩታል? ባልሰሙትስ እንዴት ያምናሉ? ያለ ሰባኪስ እንዴት ይሰማሉ?
“መልካሙን የምሥራች የሚያወሩ እግሮቻቸው እንዴት ያማሩ ናቸው?” ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ካልተላኩ እንዴት ይሰብካሉ?
ነገር ግን ሁሉም የወንጌልን ትምህርት የሰሙ አይደለም፤ ኢሳይያስም፥ “አቤቱ፥ ምስክርነታችንንስ ማን አመነ? የእግዚአብሔርስ ክንዱ ለማን ተገለጠ?” ብሎአልና።
ማመን ከመስማት ነው፤ መስማትም በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ነው።
ነገር ግን እንዲህ እላለሁ፤ በውኑ እስራኤል ብቻ አልሰሙምን? መጽሐፍ “ነገራቸው በምድር ሁሉ ተሰማ፤ ቃላቸውም እስከ ዓለም ዳርቻ ደረሰ” ብሎ የለምን?
እስራኤል ብቻ አልሰሙምን? ሙሴስ አስቀድሞ እንዲህ ብሎአቸው የለምን? “እኔ በማያስተውሉ ወገኖች አስቀናቸዋለሁ፤ ወገን ባልሆነውም አስቈጣቸዋለሁ።”
ኢሳይያስም ደፍሮ፥ “ለአልፈለጉኝ ተገኘሁ፤ ለአልጠየቁኝም ተገለጥሁላቸው” ብሏል።
Yet for Israel, He hath said, "Always I stretch forth My hand unto a people that doeth evil and transgresseth."

sections.title: The mercy of the Lord for the people of Israel.

verses.text: Therefore, I say unto you: Doth the Lord cast away His people? God forbid; for I am also of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin; I am an Israelite.
God hath not cast away His people, which He foreknew. Know ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? How he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
"O Lord, they have killed Thy prophets, and digged down Thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life."
What saith the answer of God unto him? "I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal."
Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.
According as it is written, "God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear; unto this day."
And David saith, "Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompense unto them."
Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
Therefore, I say unto you: Were they not delivered to be destroyed? Indeed not; but Israel shall be saved, for they have become a burden unto the nations through their transgressions.
Their transgression brought forth a curse upon the world; and if their iniquity was a curse unto the nations, how then was their perfection to be manifested?

sections.title: Concerning the deliverance of the people.

verses.text: I speak unto you, O nations; I, as one of the apostles unto the nations, do magnify my message.
This is as it was in these times, that it is said, "Let those who are of their kind be gathered."
If their departure is a loss to the world, how much more shall their return be? For it is life that is found in rising from the dead.
If the root be holy, so are the branches; and if the root be holy, so shall its branches also be holy.
If some of its branches be broken, thou art as a wild olive tree grafted in among them; and thou hast obtained their richness; be thou also made rich as they are.
Do not boast against the branches; for if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
The branches were broken off; and among them, it shall be said, "I am become a wild olive tree."
They did not believe, and they were broken off; but thou standest by faith. Be not high-minded, but fear; for if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest He also spare not thee.
God, in His nature, has not spared thee, as He did not spare those who were natural branches; neither shall He spare thee.
Therefore, consider the goodness and severity of God; on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in His goodness; otherwise, thou also shalt be cut off.
And they shall be cast away, for they have not believed; the Lord is able to cast them away again.

Thou art a wild vine; even if thou be cut off from thy place, and art not cut off from thy place, how can He not cast them away in the place where they have been good, even those that were in the old oil?

sections.title: Concerning the return of Israel.

verses.text: And our brethren, I desire that you should not say, "We are wise," for this mystery I wish for you to know: All nations shall be gathered, until they are united with Israel, for they have found the heart's stone of their hearts.
Henceforth, all Israel shall be saved; as it is written in the scripture, "The Deliverer shall come out of Zion; and He shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob."
And this is the covenant that I shall make with them concerning their sins at that time."
In the Gospel, they are our adversaries for your sake; but concerning the election, they are beloved for the sake of the fathers.
For there is no peace in the grace of God and in His calling.
Previously, you did not obey the Lord your God; but today, let it not be said that you do not obey them.
Likewise, you who have been taught mercy, they do not obey today so that they may receive mercy.
The Lord forgives all, for all are ensnared in sin.
How profound is the wisdom, understanding, and knowledge of the Lord! There is no search for His path; nor is there one who knows His judgment.
"Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor?"
"Who has ever given to Him, that it should be repaid to him?"
"For all things are from Him, and through Him, and to Him; to Him be glory forever. Amen."

sections.title: In Christ, the new life.

verses.text: And brethren, present your bodies as a living and holy sacrifice, pleasing to God, for this is your reasonable service.
Do not be conformed to this world; but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what is that good and acceptable and perfect will of God.

By the grace given to me, I say to everyone among you not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think, but to think with sober judgment, each according to the measure of faith that God has assigned.
For as we have many members in one body, and all the members do not have the same function,
so we, being many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another; having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, let us use them.
And God has given us different gifts according to the grace given to us. If prophecy, let us prophesy in proportion to our faith.
Let him who serves, serve with the ability which God supplies; let him who teaches, teach with the same.
Let him who exhorts, exhort; let him who gives, give with liberality; let him who leads, lead with diligence; let him who shows mercy, do so with cheerfulness.

sections.title: Concerning the various good deeds.

verses.text: Let your love be without hypocrisy; abhor what is evil; cling to what is good; pursue righteousness.
Be devoted to one another in brotherly love; outdo one another in showing honor; be of the same mind toward one another; and honor your teachers.
Do not be slothful in zeal; be fervent in spirit; serve the Lord.
Rejoice in hope; be patient in tribulation; be constant in prayer.
Assist the saints in their needs; practice hospitality toward strangers.
Kill that which causes you to stumble; but do not let it cause you to fall.
Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
Be of the same mind toward one another; do not be haughty, but associate with the lowly; do not be wise in your own sight; and do not be boastful.
Repay no one evil for evil; but give thought to do what is honorable in the sight of all.
If possible, so far as it depends on you, live peaceably with all.
And brethren, let not yourselves be provoked; do not be incensed, for it is written, “I will take vengeance; I will repay, saith the Lord.”
If your enemy be hungry, feed him; if he thirsts, give him drink; for in so doing, thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head.
Overcome evil with good, but do not be overcome by evil.

sections.title: Concerning the commandment.

verses.text: ሰው ሁሉ በበላይ ላሉ ባለሥልጣኖች ይገዛ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከአልተገኘ በቀር ሥልጣን የለምና፤ ያሉትም ባለሥልጣኖች በእግዚአብሔር የተሾሙ ናቸው።
ለባለሥልጣን አልገዛም ያለ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ እንቢ ማለቱ ነው፤ መገዛትን እንቢ የሚሉም በራሳቸው ላይ ቅጣትን ያመጣሉ።
ሹሞች ሥራው ክፉ ለሆነ ሰው እንጂ መልካም ለሚሠራ የሚአስፈሩ አይደሉም፤ ሹሞችን እንዳትፈራ ብትፈልግ መልካም አድርግ፤ እነርሱ ደግሞ ያመሰግኑሃል፤
አንተ ሥራህን ታሳምር ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር መልእክተኞች ናቸውና። ክፉ ብታደርግ ግን ፍራ፤ ሰይፍ የታጠቁም ለከንቱ አይደለም፤ ክፉ አድራጊዎችን ለመቅጣት የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋዮች ናቸውና።
ስለዚህ ቍጣን ስለ መፍራት ብቻ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ስለ ሕሊና ደግሞ መገዛት ግድ ነው።
ስለዚህም ግብር ታገቡላቸዋላችሁ፤ ለዚህ ሥራ የተሾሙ የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋዮች ናቸውና፤
ለሁሉም እንደሚገባው አድርጉ፤ ግብር ለሚገባው ግብርን ስጡ፤ ቀረጥ ለሚገባው ቀረጥን ስጡ፤ ዐሥራት ለሚገባው ዐሥራትን ስጡ፤ ሊፈሩት የሚገባውን ፍሩ፤ ክብር የሚገባውንም አክብሩ።

sections.title: Concerning the love of one's neighbor.

verses.text: Let there be no debt among you, except for the debt of love toward one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

In the beginning it has been said, "You shall not murder; you shall not commit adultery; you shall not steal; you shall not bear false witness; you shall not covet;" and there is another commandment, but the command of all is this: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
He who loves his neighbor does no harm to his neighbor; therefore, love is the fulfillment of the law.
Awaken from your sleep, for the time has come; rather than slumbering, let us rise today and go forth.
The night has passed; the day is drawing near. Therefore, let us cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armor of light.
As it is fitting for the day, let us walk in righteousness; let it not be in revelry and drunkenness, nor in sexual immorality and sensuality, nor in quarreling and jealousy.
But rather, let us put on our Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh to gratify its desires.

sections.title: Concerning the cleansing of the brethren.

verses.text: እምነቱ ደካማ የሆነውን ሰው ታገሡት፤ በዐሳቡም አትፍረዱ።
ሁሉን ይበላ ዘንድ እንደ ተፈቀደለት የሚያምን ሁሉን ይብላ፤ የሚጠራጠር ግን አትክልት ይብላ።
የሚበላውም የማይበላውን አይናቀው፤ የማይበላውም የሚበላውን አይንቀፈው፤ ሁሉንም እግዚአብሔር አውቆአቸዋልና።
እንግዲህ የሌላውን ሎሌ የምትነቅፍ አንተ ማነህ? እርሱ ቢቆም ወይም ቢወድቅ ለጌታው ነው። ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ሊያነሣው ይችላልና ይቆማል።
ከቀን ቀን የሚከለከል አለና፤ ዘወትርም የሚከለከል አለና፤ ነገር ግን ሁሉም ልቡ እንደ ወደደ ያድርግ።
አንዳንድ ቀን የተከለከለም ለእግዚአብሔር ተከለከለ፤ ዘወትር የተከለከለም ለእግዚአብሔር ተከለከለ፤ የበላም ለእግዚአብሔር በላ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ያመሰግነዋል፤ ያልበላም ለእግዚአብሔር አልበላም፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ያመሰግነዋል።
ከመካከላችንም ለራሱ የሚኖር፥ ለራሱም የሚሞት የለም።
በሕይወት ብንኖርም ለእግዚአብሔር እንኖራለን፤ ብንሞትም ለእግዚአብሔር እንሞታለን፤ እንግዲህ በሕይወት ብንኖርም ብንሞትም ለእግዚአብሔር ነን።
ስለዚህ ሕያዋንንና ሙታንን ይገዛ ዘንድ ክርስቶስ ሞተ፥ ተነሣም።
እንግዲህ በወንድምህ ላይ የምትፈርድ አንተ ምንድን ነህ? ወንድምህንስ የምትነቅፍ አንተ ምንድን ነህ? ሁላችን በክርስቶስ የፍርድ ዙፋን ፊት እንቆማለንና።
The Lord hath said, "I am the Living One; all flesh shall bow before Me; every tongue shall confess unto Me."
Behold, all of us are known to be as we stand before the Lord.

sections.title: For the sake of the neighbor, let there be no slumber.

verses.text: Therefore, from this day forward, let us not disturb one another; rather, let us consider that no one should cause his brother to stumble or to be ensnared.
As there is nothing unclean in itself, I know that in our Lord Jesus I am clean; I have been redeemed; however, for anyone who thinks anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
If you are one who is grieved by your brother because of food, you have no love; for truly, concerning Christ, if one dies for him, should he be harmed because of food?
Therefore, let us not despise the good thing that our Lord has given us.
The kingdom of God is righteousness and peace; and it is joy in the Holy Spirit, not food and drink.
Thus, what is pleasing to God is that which is done for Christ, and it is chosen among men.
Even now, let us strive to maintain peace among our brethren.
Let us not despise the creation of God for the sake of food; for all things are pure to the pure; but to those who are defiled, it is through eating that they are made unclean.
It is better for a brother to abstain from meat and from wine than to cause his brother to stumble.
If you have faith before God, let your faith strengthen you; for the mind that is found in him is pure and does not lead to destruction.
But he who is contentious shall be condemned; for it is not by faith that he acts; and whatever is done without faith is sin and iniquity.

sections.title: Concerning the assistance of one's neighbor.

verses.text: It is fitting and right that the strong should assist the weak in their weakness; let us not neglect ourselves.
Let us all be cleansed in truth and good works, that we may not neglect our neighbor.
Christ said, "The affliction that befell you has come upon me," thus it is not fitting for him to be indifferent to his own.
All that is written is for our encouragement through our sufferings and for our hope, that we may learn from it.
May the God of patience and consolation grant us to be of one mind toward one another, as Jesus Christ has willed.
Let us all be one, with one mouth, giving thanks to our Lord, Jesus Christ, to God the Father.

sections.title: And the Gospel is for the Gentiles and for the Jews concerning the Messiah.

verses.text: Now, receive your offerings; for Christ has been accepted for the glory of God.
Henceforth, I declare that Christ is a messenger of grace, fulfilling the promise of our fathers, that the word of God may be made true.
The nations shall give thanks to the Lord; for He has shown mercy upon them; as it is written in the scripture, "O Lord, thus I will praise You among the nations; I will give thanks to Your name."
Again, the scripture declares, "The nations shall rejoice with His people."
And again it is said, "All nations, give thanks to the Lord; for all the people shall give Him thanks."
Isaiah also speaks thus, "A shoot shall rise from the stump of Jesse; and he who arises from him shall be a king for the nations; and the people shall place their hope in him."
The God of hope, the Lord, by the power of the Holy Spirit, may fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope.

sections.title: The Apostolic Epistle of Paul

verses.text: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔም በጎ ምግባርን ሁሉ እንደምትፈጽሙ እታመንባችኋለሁ፤ እናንተ ፍጹም ዕውቀትን የተመላችሁ ናችሁ፤ ባልንጀሮቻችሁንም ልታስተምሩአቸው ትችላላችሁ።
ከእግዚአብሔር ስለ አገኘሁት ጸጋ ላሳስባችሁ በአንዳንድ ቦታ በድፍረት ጻፍሁላችሁ።
በአሕዛብ መካከል ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን አገለግል ዘንድ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ወንጌልም እገዛ ዘንድ፥ በእኔ ትምህርት አሕዛብ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ የተወደደና የተመረጠ መሥዋዕት ይሆኑ ዘንድ።
ለእኔም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ መመኪያዬ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ነው።
አሕዛብም እንዲያምኑ ክርስቶስ በቃልም በሥራም ያደረገልኝን እናገር ዘንድ እደፍራለሁ።
በኀይልና በተአምራት፥ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ኀይልና ድንቅ ሥራን በመሥራትም፥ ከኢየሩሳሌም አውራጃዎች ጀምሬ እስከ እልዋሪቆን ድረስ እንደ አስተማርሁ፥ የክርስቶስንም ወንጌል ፈጽሞ እንደ ሰበክሁ እናገር ዘንድ እደፍራለሁ።
ወንጌልን ለማስተማር ተጋሁ፤ ነገር ግን በሌላ መሠረት ላይ እንዳላንጽ የክርስቶስ ስም ወደ ተጠራበት አልሄድሁም።
“ወሬው ያልደረሳቸው ያውቁታል፤ ያልሰሙትም ያስተውሉታል” ብሎ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተናገረ ነው።
ዘወትር ወደ እናንተ ልመጣ እወድድ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ተሳነኝ።
አሁን ግን በዚህ ሀገር ሥራዬን ስለ ጨረስሁ፥ ከብዙ ጊዜም ጀምሮ ወደ እናንተ ልመጣ እተጋ ስለ ነበር፤
And I will go to Assyria; I shall place my hope in the way that leads to you. For I have rejoiced with you before, and afterwards I shall go from you to there.

sections.title: Concerning the assistance of the faithful.

verses.text: Now, however, I shall go to Jerusalem to assist the saints.
Macedonia and Achaia have been pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.
For it is fitting that they should assist them in their bodily needs, since they have shared in their spiritual blessings.
Therefore, I shall complete this fruit and shall go to you toward Spain.
But I trust that, in due time, the fullness of blessing in the gospel of Christ will come to you.
Brothers, I urge you to join me in prayer to God on my behalf, that through our Lord Jesus Christ and the love of the Holy Spirit, I may be refreshed together with you.
This is so that the saints in Jerusalem may be glad through my ministry, and that I may be aided by the brethren who are in Judea.
And if God wills, I shall come to you with joy, and be refreshed in your company.
May the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
I commend to you our sister Phoebe, who is a servant of the church at Cenchreae;
Receive her in the Lord as is fitting for the saints, for she has been a helper of many, and of myself also;
Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
For they risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles;
Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Greet my beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia to Christ.
Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
Greet Andronicus and Junia, my countrymen and fellow prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.
Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
Speak peace to Herodion, who is of the times; and to those who dwell in the house of Nyrqasos, and to the faithful who believe in Christ, speak peace.
In the name of our Lord, speak peace to those who have received affliction, to the brethren of Tirophimos and Tirophimos. In the name of our Lord, speak peace to our sister who has suffered greatly.
Speak peace to Rufus, whom our Lord has chosen, and to his mother, and to my mother, who is also hers.
Speak peace to Asyncritus, to Phlegon, to Hermes, to Patrobas, to Hermas, and to our brethren who are with them.
Speak peace to Philologus, to Julia, to Nereus, and to his sister, to Olympas, and to all the saints who are with them.
May peace abound among you, greeting one another with a holy kiss; may the Church of Christ greet you with peace.
Brethren, I admonish you to be aware of those who cause divisions and offenses contrary to the doctrine which you learned; avoid them.
For they do not serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by smooth words and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the simple.
Your obedience has become known to all; therefore I rejoice over you; but I desire you to be wise in what is good, and simple concerning evil.
And the God of peace will crush Satan under your feet shortly; the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
Timothy, who works with me, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, greet you in peace.
I, Tertius, who wrote this letter, greet you in the Lord.
Gaius, who has hosted me and all the church, greets you; Erastus, the city treasurer, and our brother Quartus greet you.
He who was able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery kept secret since the world began, is God.

This was made known through the prophetic writings, and by the command of the eternal God, to bring about the obedience of faith among all nations, that they may believe in the Son of God, Jesus Christ.
To God alone wise, be glory through Jesus Christ forever. Amen.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
